slides.title: Exercise V - Cycle - 1
slides.body:
Using the scheme in the next page, answer the following questions:
1. Draw the v-cycle using the main milestone of the project;
2. Analize ECU1 timeline from 2019 to 2022 describing all the phases; (voids in the timeline,
colours, ends)
3. What is a PCR?
4. Why PCR’s timeline is shifted compared to the single ECUs one?
5. What kind of activitiy would you do on a PCR software release?
6. Describe the VP fleet timeline; (Relationships with other timeline, specifically with vehicle
timeline, Quality gate, requirements, PCR)
7. What is the J1? What do you think is it the preparation in factories before J1 date? Are there
activities related to the SW before/during J1?
8. General analysis of the plan;
Exercise V-Cycle - 1
